name: Dane
source:
Dane is a 2D harem dating sim, RPG, and visual novel set in a horny Viking fantasy world, featuring open-world gameplay.

You play as a fearless warrior who wakes up on the riverbank... bruised, confused, and rescued by a beautiful milf and her daughter. With nowhere else to go, you settle into their lustful little village, where nearly every character is a walking fantasy just waiting to be... explored.

Spend your days exploring a mysterious Viking village and uncover all its secrets. Meet friendly characters, many of whom you can get to know intimately and date. Fight rival Vikings to become the most powerful warrior in the land.

[from [url=https://bosomstudio.itch.io/dane]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Dane》是一款2D后宫约会模拟游戏、角色扮演游戏和视觉小说，以维京海盗奇幻世界为背景，采用开放世界游戏玩法。

你扮演一个无所畏惧的战士，在河岸上醒来……遍体鳞伤、困惑不解，最后被一个美丽的熟女和她的女儿救了。由于无处可去，你定居在他们淫荡的小村庄里，那里几乎每个角色都是行走的幻想，等待着……探索。

花时间探索神秘的维京村庄并揭开它的所有秘密。结识友好的人物，其中许多人你可以亲密认识并约会。与竞争对手维京人战斗，成为这片土地上最强大的战士。

[来自[url=https://bosomstudio.itch.io/dane]itch.io[/url]]
